faqs.question: Why VUAA (Vanguard S&P 500 UCITS ETF)?
faqs.answer: VUAA tracks the S&P 500 index, providing instant ownership in 500 of America's leading companies (including Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, and Berkshire Hathaway) in one simple fund. It features an ultra-low expense ratio of just 0.07% per year and automatically reinvests dividends (accumulating), which maximizes compounding without triggering dividend income taxes or extra transaction fees.

faqs.question: Why is automated ETF investing better than average?
faqs.answer: Most investors underperform the market by trying to time it or picking individual stocks. By automating a broad S&P 500 ETF, you secure market returns with low costs.
